name: La Mauricie National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed only in the developed campgrounds and along the Parkway, not on trails.
summary: Pets are allowed only in the developed campgrounds and along the Parkway, not on trails.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not permitted in most areas of the park.
They are only allowed in the developed campgrounds (Mistagance, Wapizagonke and Rivière-à-la-Pêche) and the Parkway corridor, including the rest stops and picnic areas along the Parkway.

dogRules.text: Allowed only in Mistagance, Wapizagonke and Rivière-à-la-Pêche campgrounds and along the Parkway, its rest stops and picnic areas.
Not allowed on trails or beaches, in boats, the backcountry, public buildings, oTENTiks, La Clairière group campground or cabins.
